title: Optimization of Insect Genomic DNA and Total RNA Extraction Protocols
author: Eliza F. de Melo Bellard do Nascimento
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1928/v1
materials: Extractions were performed from CLM pupae collected in Coffea arabica leaves during the dry and hot season, from April to September 2021, in the brazilian savanna region of the central plateau (experimental field of Embrapa Cerrados, Planaltina - DF, latitude: 15° 35' 30' 'S, longitude 47° 42' 30'' W). The E.Z.N.A insect DNA kit (Omega BioTek, Cat. No.: D0926-02) was used to obtain the insect gDNA. However, considerable modifications of the protocol provided by the kit was required in order to obtain a higher amount and quality of gDNA extracted.

Protein Digestion: add 100 mg of proteinase K (Invitrogen, Cat. No.: AM2544 ) to the tube containing the macerated tissue in CTL buffer, slowly invert 10 times and incubate for 16 hours at 37 °C under mild agitation (100 rpm) (Incubator Shaker Ecotron - Infors HT).

RNAse digestion: add 0,06 ng of RNAse A (Invitrogen, Cat. No.: 12091021) to the microtube from the previous step containing the aqueous phase. Carefully invert 10 times and keep at 37 °C for 30 minutes. Add 500 μL of BL buffer and carefully invert the tube 20 times and incubate for 10 minutes 70 °C.

The extractions were performed of 7 stages of development from CLM: 4 larval instars (L1, L2, L3 and L4) (Motta et al., 2021), pupae, males and females. TRIzol® method was used, followed by RNA cleanup with ReliaPrep RNA Tissue Miniprep System kit (Promega, Cat.No.: PRZ6111).

Cell lysis: with the aid of a mortar and pestle, macerate separately the different stages of development (approximately 20 μL of powder per tube) with liquid nitrogen. Dissolve the material in a sterile 1,5 mL microfuge tube containing 1 mL of TRIzol® Reagent (Invitrogen, Cat.No.: 15596026). Invert the tube carefully 10 times and incubate it for 5 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Cell Lysis (gDNA)
steps.instruction: Macerate 20 pupae (approximately 10 mg) in 700 uL of lysis buffer (CTL) for 2 minutes using a Dounce tissue grinder or homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube using a 1 mL automatic pipette with a wide terminus tip.

steps.title: DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from the lysate using chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the microtube and carefully invert 20 times (do not vortex).
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 2 minutes at room temperature (RT) using an Eppendorf 5415R Microcentrifuge.
Transfer approximately 500 uL of the upper aqueous phase to a fresh 2 mL tube using a 1 mL automatic pipette with a wide terminus tip, discarding the interface debris.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA by adding ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μL of 100% ethanol to the microtube.
Mix by slowly inverting the tube 20 times (do not vortex).

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using a Mini Column HiBand DNA column and collect tube.

substeps.instruction: Load 750 μL of the mixture onto the column using a 1 μL automatic pipette with a wide terminus tip.
Centrifuge at 15,000 g for 30 seconds; discard flow-through and repeat until the sample is processed, performing the final centrifugation for 1 minute.
Add 500 μL of HBC buffer and centrifuge at 15,000 g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Load 700 μL of wash buffer (kit provided) and repeat centrifugation and cleaning.
Place the column in a fresh microtube.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the bound DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 15,000 g for 2 minutes to remove binding buffer traces and place in a fresh 1.5 mL microtube.
Carefully load 15 uL of elution buffer (kit provided) onto the middle of the column membrane.
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 15,000 g for 30 seconds to collect the DNA.
Repeat the elution step to maximize yield.

steps.title: DNA Quality Assessment and Storage
steps.instruction: Evaluate DNA concentration and quality and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Assess DNA using NanoDrop, Qubit, agarose gel electrophoresis, or Femto Pulser.
Store samples at 4°C (or -20°C if necessary, though quality may be compromised).

steps.title: Organic Extraction (RNA)
steps.instruction: Perform organic extraction to remove impurities from RNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C (Eppendorf 5415R) to precipitate impurities.
Transfer the supernatant to a new sterile 1.5 mL microfuge tube containing 200 mL of chloroform.
Agitate vigorously by manual inversion for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 3 minutes at RT.
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microtube containing 500 μL of isopropanol.
Slowly invert the tube 10 times and incubate for 10 minutes at RT.
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C to sediment the RNA and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: RNA Cleaning
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol to the pellet.
Carefully invert the tube 5 times.
Centrifuge at 10,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the ethanol and dry the pellet at RT.

steps.title: RNA Purification (ReliaPrep System)
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using the ReliaPrep RNA Tissue Miniprep System.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in 250 μL of LBA/TG solution and add 85 μL of isopropanol.
Insert the sample into a ReliaPrep Mini Column and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 1 minute at RT; discard flow-through.
Add 500 μL of RNA Wash Solution to the top of the column and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 30 s at RT.
Prepare a DNAse mix (24 μL Yellow Core Buffer + 3 μL MnCl2 + 3 μL DNAse), add to the column, and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 200 μL of Column Wash solution and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 15 minutes at RT.
Add 500 μL of RNA Wash Solution and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 30 s at RT; discard flow-through.
Add 300 μL of RNA Wash Solution and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 2 minutes at RT.
Transfer the column to a fresh microtube, add 15 μL of RNAse free water to the top, and centrifuge at 10,000 g for 1 minute at RT.

steps.title: RNA Quality Assessment and Storage
steps.instruction: Evaluate RNA concentration and quality and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Assess RNA using NanoDrop, Qubit, and Bioanalyzer.
Store RNA immediately in a -80°C freezer to prevent degradation.
